title: Kumbhakarna reassures Ravana
introduction: Kumbhakarna abuses Ravana for his utter disregard of the earlier advices given by his well-wishers like Vibhishana, due to his sheer arrogance and neglect of the scriptures which enumerate the king's duties. Ravana replies to Kumbhakarna that bygone is a bygone and asks him to proceed to the battle-front. Then, Kumbhakarna reassures Ravana and promises him that all the adversaries would be destroyed by him in the ensuing battle.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 63nd Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य राक्षसराजस्य निशम्य परिदेवितम् |
कुम्भकर्णो बभा षेदं वचनम् प्रजहास च
verses.iast:
tasya rākṣasarājasya niśamya paridevitam |
kumbhakarṇo babhā ṣedaṃ vacanam prajahāsa ca
verses.translation: Hearing the lamentation of Ravana, Kumbhakarna laughed at a full volume and spoke as follows:

glosses.meaning: after laughing at a full volume.

verses.devanagari:
दृष्टो दोषो हि योऽस्माभिः पुरा मन्त्रविनिर्णये |
हितेष्वनभियुक्तेन सोऽयमासादितस्त्वया
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭo doṣo hi yo'smābhiḥ purā mantravinirṇaye |
hiteṣvanabhiyuktena so'yamāsāditastvayā
verses.translation: "The same bad consequence, which was imagined by us earlier while taking the final decision after our consultation, is faced by you now, due to your utter disregard of the words spoken by your well-wishers."

glosses.meaning: at a settlement of our counsel
due to the disregard of well-wishers

verses.devanagari:
श्रीघ्रम् खल्वभ्युपेतम् त्वाम् फलम् पापस्य कर्मणः |
निरयेष्वेव पतनम् यथा दुष्कृतकर्मणः
verses.iast:
śrīghram khalvabhyupetam tvām phalam pāpasya karmaṇaḥ |
nirayeṣveva patanam yathā duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "How a doer of wicked deeds indeed falls into damnation, so also a punishment for your sinful act has indeed reached your fast."

glosses.meaning: a punishment for your sinful act

verses.devanagari:
प्रथमम् वै महाराज कृत्यमेतदचिन्तितम् |
केवलम् वीर्यदर्पेणनानुबन्धो विचिन्तितः
verses.iast:
prathamam vai mahārāja kṛtyametadacintitam |
kevalam vīryadarpeṇanānubandho vicintitaḥ
verses.translation: "O emperor! This course of action was not excepted by you at first. You did not conceive this consequence, only because of your sheer arrogance of power."

glosses.meaning: only because of your arrogance of power.

verses.devanagari:
यः पश्चात्पूर्वकार्याणि कुर्यादैश्वर्यमास्थितः |
पूर्वं चोत्तरकार्याणि न स वेद नयानयौ
verses.iast:
yaḥ paścātpūrvakāryāṇi kuryādaiśvaryamāsthitaḥ |
pūrvaṃ cottarakāryāṇi na sa veda nayānayau
verses.translation: "He who, abiding in power, performs duties to be done earlier at a later stage and duties to be done later, at an early stage, does not know what is a right course and what is a wrong course."

glosses.meaning: duties to be done at first
and duties to be done later
the right course and the wrong course.

verses.devanagari:
देशकालविहीनानि कर्माणि विपरीतवत् |
क्रियमाणानि दुष्यन्ति हवीम्ष्यप्रयतेष्विव
verses.iast:
deśakālavihīnāni karmāṇi viparītavat |
kriyamāṇāni duṣyanti havīmṣyaprayateṣviva
verses.translation: "Action done perversely, regardless of space and time, get spoiled like offering oblations without properly making the fire well-prepared."

verses.devanagari:
त्रयाणाम् पञ्चधा योगम् कर्मणाम् यः प्रपद्यते |
सचिवैः समयम् कृत्वा स सम्यगभिवर्तते
verses.iast:
trayāṇām paJṇcadhā yogam karmaṇām yaḥ prapadyate |
sacivaiḥ samayam kṛtvā sa samyagabhivartate
verses.translation: "He, who acts according to an agreement done with his counsellors, considering three types of duties*, by harassing five types of means**, moves along a right course."
notes: *1). Conclusion of peace through conciliation. 2) acceptance of allegiance through gift. 3) invasion, as a method of coercion. **1) The method of initiating an actions. 2) Personality and material to be worked upon. 3) Time and place of action. 4) Provision against mischance and 5) chances of success.

verses.devanagari:
यथागमम् च यो राजा समयम् च चिकीर्षति |
बुध्यते सचिवैर्बुद्ध्या सुहृदश्चानुपश्यति
verses.iast:
yathāgamam ca yo rājā samayam ca cikīrṣati |
budhyate sacivairbuddhyā suhṛdaścānupaśyati
verses.translation: "A king who wishes to execute am agreement as per law, understands it through his own intellect as well as the counsellors and discovers it through his friends, is on a right course."

verses.devanagari:
धर्ममर्थम् च कामम् च सर्वान्वा रक्षसाम् पते |
भजते पुरुषः काले त्रिणि द्वन्द्वानि वा पुनः
verses.iast:
dharmamartham ca kāmam ca sarvānvā rakṣasām pate |
bhajate puruṣaḥ kāle triṇi dvandvāni vā punaḥ
verses.translation: "O king of demons! A man resorts to virtue or worldly gain or pleasure or all the three together or a twin combination of virtue and worldly gain or virtue and pleasure or worldly gain and pleasure or worldly gain and pleasure, according to an appointed time*."
notes: *The scriptures lay down that virtue should be pursued in the morning, worldly gain in the afternoon and sensuous pleasure at night. As an alternative, one is called upon to pursue

glosses.meaning: or again a twin combination of virtue and wealth or virtue and pleasure or wealth and pleasure

verses.devanagari:
त्रिषु चैतेषु यच्छ्रेष्ठम् श्रुत्वा तन्नावबुध्यते |
राजा वा राजमात्रो वा व्यर्थम् तस्य बहु श्रुतम्
verses.iast:
triṣu caiteṣu yacchreṣṭham śrutvā tannāvabudhyate |
rājā vā rājamātro vā vyartham tasya bahu śrutam
verses.translation: "That sovereign king or crown prince, who, having heard which one is the best out of these three but does not keep it in mind, his extensive learning would be in vain."

glosses.meaning: does not keep it in mind

verses.devanagari:
उपप्रदानम् सान्त्वम् च भेदम् काले च विक्रमम् |
योगम् च रक्षसाम् श्रेष्ठ तावुभौ च नयानयौ
काले धर्मार्थकामान्यः सम्मन्त्य्र सचिवैह् सह |
निषेवेतात्मवान् लोके न स व्यसनमाप्नुयात्
verses.iast:
upapradānam sāntvam ca bhedam kāle ca vikramam |
yogam ca rakṣasām śreṣṭha tāvubhau ca nayānayau
kāle dharmārthakāmānyaḥ sammantyra sacivaih saha |
niṣevetātmavān loke na sa vyasanamāpnuyāt
verses.translation: "O the foremost of demons! Whosoever deliberates with his counsellors and resorts to an act of with his counsellors and resorts to an act of bestowing gifts or conciliation or sowing dissension at appropriate occasion or exhibits valour or resorts to them all together or takes recourse to both right action and the reverse of it at the right time or pursues virtue or worldly gain or pleasure at the appropriate time, that intelligent person never confronts a misfortune in this world."

glosses.meaning: or resorts to them al together
right action and the reverse of it
or pursues virtue or worldly gain or pleasure

verses.devanagari:
हितानुबन्धमालोक्य कुर्यात्कार्यमिहात्मनः |
राजा सहार्थतत्त्वज्ञैः सचिवैर्बुद्धिजीविभिः
verses.iast:
hitānubandhamālokya kuryātkāryamihātmanaḥ |
rājā sahārthatattvajJṇaiḥ sacivairbuddhijīvibhiḥ
verses.translation: "A sovereign has to do an act here, looking into his welfare as a consequence along with his counsellors who make their subsistence by their intelligence and who understand the true state of the things."

glosses.meaning: and understanding the true state of the things.

verses.devanagari:
अनभिज्ज़्नाय शास्त्रार्थान् पुरुषाः पशुबुद्धयः |
प्रागल्भ्याद्वक्त्मिच्छिन्ति मन्त्रेष्वभ्यन्तरीकृताः
verses.iast:
anabhijJnāya śāstrārthān puruṣāḥ paśubuddhayaḥ |
prāgalbhyādvaktmicchinti mantreṣvabhyantarīkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: "Men with brutal ideas, who are initiated in discussions, aspire to tell haughty things, without fully knowing the precepts of the scriptures."

verses.devanagari:
अशास्त्रविदुषाम् तेषाम् कार्यम् नाभिहितं वचः |
अर्थशास्त्रानभिज्ञानाम् विपुलाम् श्रियमिच्छताम्
verses.iast:
aśāstraviduṣām teṣām kāryam nābhihitaṃ vacaḥ |
arthaśāstrānabhijJṇānām vipulām śriyamicchatām
verses.translation: "The words spoken by those who did not know the scriptures, who do not recollect the books dealing with practical life and who covet for abundant wealth are not to be implemented."

glosses.meaning: who do not know the scriptures
who do not recollect the books dealing with practical life

verses.devanagari:
अहितम् च हिताकारम् धार्ष्ट्याज्जल्पन्ति ये नराः |
अवश्यम् मन्त्रबाह्यास्ते कर्तव्याः कृत्यदूषकाः
verses.iast:
ahitam ca hitākāram dhārṣṭyājjalpanti ye narāḥ |
avaśyam mantrabāhyāste kartavyāḥ kṛtyadūṣakāḥ
verses.translation: "Those men who talk with audacity, some inimical things in a friendly way, are to be kept out of deliberations, as they certainly spoil the work to be done."

glosses.meaning: spoil the work to be done.

verses.devanagari:
विनाशयन्तो भर्तारम् सहिताः शत्रुभिर्बुधैः |
विपरीतानि कृत्यानि कारयन्तीह मन्त्रिणः
verses.iast:
vināśayanto bhartāram sahitāḥ śatrubhirbudhaiḥ |
viparītāni kṛtyāni kārayantīha mantriṇaḥ
verses.translation: "Some counsellors, colluding with some learned adversaries, spoil their king and make them do wrong deeds."

verses.devanagari:
तान् भर्ता मित्रसम्काशानमित्रान् मन्त्रनिर्णये |
व्यवहारेण जानीयात्सचिवानुपसम्हितान्
verses.iast:
tān bhartā mitrasamkāśānamitrān mantranirṇaye |
vyavahāreṇa jānīyātsacivānupasamhitān
verses.translation: "The king should make-out those ministers who have been transformed by the enemy to their side (through bribery and other things) and are enemies though looking like friends, through their conduct when a final decision is being taken after deliberation."

glosses.meaning: when a final settlement is taken after deliberation
who were transformed by bribery and other things

verses.devanagari:
चपलस्येह कृत्यानि सहसानुप्रधावतः |
चिद्रमन्ये प्रपद्यन्ते क्रौञ्चस्य खमिव द्विजाः
verses.iast:
capalasyeha kṛtyāni sahasānupradhāvataḥ |
cidramanye prapadyante krauJṇcasya khamiva dvijāḥ
verses.translation: "Outsiders find out the fickleness of a ruler, who is led away by false appearances and quickly performs the acts, as birds discover the hole (made by the arrow of Skanda, the commander-in-chief of gods) in the Kruancha mountain."

glosses.meaning: the fickleness (of a ruler) anupradhaavataH = who is led away by false appearances
(discover) the hole (made by the arrow of Skanda

verses.devanagari:
यो हि शत्रुमवज्ञाय नात्मानमभिरक्षति |
अवाप्नोति हि सोऽनर्थान् स्थानाच्च व्यवरोप्यते
verses.iast:
yo hi śatrumavajJṇāya nātmānamabhirakṣati |
avāpnoti hi so'narthān sthānācca vyavaropyate
verses.translation: "A king who disregards an enemy and does not protect himself, indeed faces disappointing occurrences and would be removed from his position."

verses.devanagari:
यदुक्तमिह ते पूर्वम् क्रियतामनुजेन च |
तदेव नो हितम् वाक्यम् यदिच्छसि च तत्कुरु
verses.iast:
yaduktamiha te pūrvam kriyatāmanujena ca |
tadeva no hitam vākyam yadicchasi ca tatkuru
verses.translation: "That advice which was tendered to you earlier by vibhishana is beneficial to us. Do whatever you wish to do."

verses.devanagari:
तत्तु श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः कुम्भकर्णस्य भाषितम् |
भ्रुकुटिम् चैव संचक्रे क्रुद्धश्चैनमभाषत
verses.iast:
tattu śrutvā daśagrīvaḥ kumbhakarṇasya bhāṣitam |
bhrukuṭim caiva saṃcakre kruddhaścainamabhāṣata
verses.translation: On hearing those words of Kumbhakarna, Ravana, on his part, twisted his eye-brows in anger and spoke the following words:

verses.devanagari:
मन्यो गुरुरिवाचार्यः कि माम् त्वमनुशाससे |
किमेवम् वाक्ष्रमम् कृत्वा काले युक्तम् विधीयताम्
verses.iast:
manyo gururivācāryaḥ ki mām tvamanuśāsase |
kimevam vākśramam kṛtvā kāle yuktam vidhīyatām
verses.translation: "Why are you advising me like a venerable great teacher? What is the use in getting wearied of your speech? Let a work, most befitting of time, be performed."

verses.devanagari:
विभ्रमाच्चित्तमोहाद्वा बलवीर्याश्रयेण वा |
नाभिपन्नमिदानीम् यद्व्यर्था तस्य पुनः कथा
verses.iast:
vibhramāccittamohādvā balavīryāśrayeṇa vā |
nābhipannamidānīm yadvyarthā tasya punaḥ kathā
verses.translation: "Now, it is a waste to tell again of that act which was wrongly done before, either by mistake or by an illusion of mind or by taking shelter in strength and prowess."

glosses.meaning: or by taking shelter in strength or prowess.

verses.devanagari:
अस्मिन् काले तु यद्युक्तम् तदिदानीम् विचिन्त्यताम् |
गतम् तु नानुशोचन्ति गतम् तु गतमेव हि
verses.iast:
asmin kāle tu yadyuktam tadidānīm vicintyatām |
gatam tu nānuśocanti gatam tu gatameva hi
verses.translation: "Let whatever be appropriate at this moment be thought of now. Wise men do not repent over the past. Past is indeed but the past."

verses.devanagari:
ममापनयजं दुःखम् विक्रमेण समीकुरु |
यदि खल्वस्ति मे स्नेहो विक्रमम् वाधिगच्छसि
यदि कार्यम् ममैतत्ते हृदि कार्यतमम् मतम् |
verses.iast:
mamāpanayajaṃ duḥkham vikrameṇa samīkuru |
yadi khalvasti me sneho vikramam vādhigacchasi
yadi kāryam mamaitatte hṛdi kāryatamam matam |
verses.translation: "If you have affection indeed for me or if you discover your own prowess and if you think it fit in your heart that my work is to be done very much, you nullify the hardship, born out of my wicked conduct, by your prowess."

glosses.meaning: very much is to be done
born out of my wicked conduct.

verses.devanagari:
स सुहृद्यो विपन्नार्थम् दीनमभ्युपपद्यते
स बन्धुर्योऽपनीतेषु साहाय्यायोपकल्पते |
verses.iast:
sa suhṛdyo vipannārtham dīnamabhyupapadyate
sa bandhuryo'panīteṣu sāhāyyāyopakalpate |
verses.translation: "He who rescues an afflicted soul, whose fortune is ruined, he is the real friend. He who is ready at hand to help those who have deviated from the right course, is a kinsman."

glosses.meaning: those who have deviated from the right course

verses.devanagari:
तमथैवम् ब्रुवाणम् स वचनम् धीरदारुणम्
रुष्ट्ऽयमिति विज्ञाय शनैः श्लक्ष्णमुवाच ह |
verses.iast:
tamathaivam bruvāṇam sa vacanam dhīradāruṇam
ruṣṭ'yamiti vijJṇāya śanaiḥ ślakṣṇamuvāca ha |
verses.translation: Thereupon, hearing those deeply harsh words spoken by Ravana and understanding that he is quite enraged, Kumbhakarna spoke slowly and smoothly.

verses.devanagari:
अतीव हि समालक्ष्य भ्रातरम् क्षुभितेन्द्रियम्
कुम्भकर्णः शनैर्वाक्यम् बभाषे परिसान्त्वयन् |
verses.iast:
atīva hi samālakṣya bhrātaram kṣubhitendriyam
kumbhakarṇaḥ śanairvākyam babhāṣe parisāntvayan |
verses.translation: Observing that his brother is highly perturbed and excited of his senses, Kumbhakarna, while consoling him, gently spoke the following words:

glosses.meaning: perturbed and excited of is senses

verses.devanagari:
शृणु राजन्नवहितो मम वाक्यमरिंदम
अलम् राक्षसराजेन्द्र सम्तापमुपपद्य ते |
रोषम् च सम्परित्यज्य स्वस्थो चवितुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
śṛṇu rājannavahito mama vākyamariṃdama
alam rākṣasarājendra samtāpamupapadya te |
roṣam ca samparityajya svastho cavitumarhasi
verses.translation: "O king, the annihilator of adversaries! Listen to my words attentively. O emperor of demons! Enough of your giving way to the anguish. Abandoning your anger completely, you ought to be your normal self again."

glosses.meaning: to be svasthaH = your normal self.

verses.devanagari:
नैतन्मनसि कर्तव्यम् मयि जीवति पार्थिव |
तमहम् नाशयिष्यामि यत्कृते परितप्येते
verses.iast:
naitanmanasi kartavyam mayi jīvati pārthiva |
tamaham nāśayiṣyāmi yatkṛte paritapyete
verses.translation: "O king! Until I live, this idea should not be formed in your mind. I shall destroy him, for whose account, you are feeling anguished."

verses.devanagari:
अवश्यम् च हितम् वाच्यम् सर्वावस्थाम् गतम् मया |
बन्धुभावादभिहितम् भ्रातृस्नेहाच्च पार्थिव
verses.iast:
avaśyam ca hitam vācyam sarvāvasthām gatam mayā |
bandhubhāvādabhihitam bhrātṛsnehācca pārthiva
verses.translation: "O king! In whatever situation you are placed, I have to give certainly a good advice to you. I gave this advice, because of our relation and brotherly affection."

verses.devanagari:
सदृशम् यच्च कालेऽस्मिन् कर्तुम् स्नेहेन बन्धुना |
शत्रूणाम् कदनम् पश्य क्रियमाणम् मया रणे
verses.iast:
sadṛśam yacca kāle'smin kartum snehena bandhunā |
śatrūṇām kadanam paśya kriyamāṇam mayā raṇe
verses.translation: "See that which is to be done and this juncture, out of affection by a brother, viz. the destruction of adversaries in battle, will be done by me."

verses.devanagari:
अद्य पश्य महाबाहो मया समरमूर्धनि |
हते रामे सहभ्रात्रा द्रवन्तीम् हरिवाहिनीम्
verses.iast:
adya paśya mahābāho mayā samaramūrdhani |
hate rāme sahabhrātrā dravantīm harivāhinīm
verses.translation: "See today, O mighty armed king, the fleeing army of monkeys and Rama along with his brother being killed by me in the fore-front of the battle-field."

verses.devanagari:
अद्य रामस्य तद्दृष्ट्वा मयानीतम् रणाच्छिरः |
सुखि भव महाबाहो सीता भवतु दुःखिता
verses.iast:
adya rāmasya taddṛṣṭvā mayānītam raṇācchiraḥ |
sukhi bhava mahābāho sītā bhavatu duḥkhitā
verses.translation: "O the mighty armed! Be happy by seeing that Rama's head, which I shall bring today from the battle. Let Seetha be unhappy."

verses.devanagari:
अद्य रामस्य पश्यन्तु निधनम् सुमहत्प्रियम् |
लङ्कायाम् राक्षसाः सर्वे ये ते निहतबान्धवाः
verses.iast:
adya rāmasya paśyantu nidhanam sumahatpriyam |
laṇ^kāyām rākṣasāḥ sarve ye te nihatabāndhavāḥ
verses.translation: "Let all those demons in Lanka, whose relatives have died in battle, witness the death of the most beloved Rama today."

verses.devanagari:
अद्य शोकपरीतानाम् स्वबन्धुवधशोचिनाम् |
शत्रोर्युधि विनाशेन करोम्यश्रुप्रमार्जनम्
verses.iast:
adya śokaparītānām svabandhuvadhaśocinām |
śatroryudhi vināśena karomyaśrupramārjanam
verses.translation: "Today, I shall do the act of wiping off tears of demons, who have been afflicted with grief and lamenting because of the destruction of their relatives in combat by the adversaries."

glosses.meaning: the act of wiping off tears
of demons who are afflicted with grief
lamenting by the annihilation of their relatives
due to destroyable by the adversaries

verses.devanagari:
अद्य पर्वतसम्काशम् ससूर्यमिव तोयदम् |
विकीर्णम् पश्य समरे सुग्रीवम् प्लवगेश्वरम्
verses.iast:
adya parvatasamkāśam sasūryamiva toyadam |
vikīrṇam paśya samare sugrīvam plavageśvaram
verses.translation: "See today in battle, the mountain-like Sugreeva, the king of monkeys, looking like a cloud illuminated by the sun, thrown about, dissipated."

verses.devanagari:
कथम् च राक्षसैरेभिर्मया च परिसान्त्वितः |
जिघांसुभिर्दाशरथिम् व्यथसे त्वमिहानघ
verses.iast:
katham ca rākṣasairebhirmayā ca parisāntvitaḥ |
jighāṃsubhirdāśarathim vyathase tvamihānagha
verses.translation: "O faultless Ravana! Why are you agitated now, when you are being consoled by those demons and by me, who are desirous of killing Rama?"

verses.devanagari:
माम् निहत्य किल त्वाम् हि निहनिष्यति राघवः |
नाहामात्मनि सम्तापम् गच्छेयम् राक्षसाधिप
verses.iast:
mām nihatya kila tvām hi nihaniṣyati rāghavaḥ |
nāhāmātmani samtāpam gaccheyam rākṣasādhipa
verses.translation: "O king of demons! Rama will indeed kill you, only after killing me. On that account, I do not regret for myself."

verses.devanagari:
कामम् त्विदानीमपि माम् व्यादिश त्वम् परम्तप |
न परः प्रेक्षणीयस्ते युद्धायातुलविक्रम
verses.iast:
kāmam tvidānīmapi mām vyādiśa tvam paramtapa |
na paraḥ prekṣaṇīyaste yuddhāyātulavikrama
verses.translation: "O Ravana, having unequal prowess and the annihilator of enemies! You can command me, even now, as you wish. No other person need be sought, for a dispatch to the battle."

verses.devanagari:
अहमुत्सादयिष्यामि शत्रूंस्तव महाबलान् |
यदि शक्रो यदि यमो यदि पावकमारुतौ
तानहम् योधयिष्यामि कुबेरवरुणावपि |
verses.iast:
ahamutsādayiṣyāmi śatrūṃstava mahābalān |
yadi śakro yadi yamo yadi pāvakamārutau
tānaham yodhayiṣyāmi kuberavaruṇāvapi |
verses.translation: "I can destroy your enemies, who have a great strength. I can engage in combat with all those persons, whether he is Indra or Yama or the fire-god to the wind-god or even Varuna."

glosses.meaning: or the fire god or the wind-god

verses.devanagari:
गिरिमात्रशरीरस्य शितशूलधरस्य मे
नर्दतस्तीक्ष्णदम्ष्ट्रस्य बिभीयाद्वै पुरंदरः |
verses.iast:
girimātraśarīrasya śitaśūladharasya me
nardatastīkṣṇadamṣṭrasya bibhīyādvai puraṃdaraḥ |
verses.translation: "Indra also gets frightened of me, having a mountain-sized body wielding a sharpened pike, having pointed tusks and even as I roar."

verses.devanagari:
अथवा त्यक्तशस्त्रस्य मृद्नतस्तरसा रिपून्
न मे प्रतिमुखः कश्चित् स्थातुम् शक्तो जिजीविषुः |
verses.iast:
athavā tyaktaśastrasya mṛdnatastarasā ripūn
na me pratimukhaḥ kaścit sthātum śakto jijīviṣuḥ |
verses.translation: "Even otherwise, no one can stand alive in front of me, who is even weaponless and smashing the enemies by me strength alone."

glosses.meaning: who has given up all weapons

verses.devanagari:
नैव शक्त्या न गदया नासिना निशितैः शरैः
हस्ताभ्यामेव सम्रब्धो हनिष्याम्यपि वज्रिणम् |
verses.iast:
naiva śaktyā na gadayā nāsinā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
hastābhyāmeva samrabdho haniṣyāmyapi vajriṇam |
verses.translation: "Without using a javelin or a mace or a sword or sharp arrows, I myself, on getting excited, can kill even Indra, with my bare hands."

verses.devanagari:
यदि मे मुष्टिवेगम् स राघवोऽद्य सहिष्यति
ततः पास्यन्ति बाणौघा रुधिरम् राघवस्य मे |
verses.iast:
yadi me muṣṭivegam sa rāghavo'dya sahiṣyati
tataḥ pāsyanti bāṇaughā rudhiram rāghavasya me |
verses.translation: "If Rama today survives even after facing the rapid blows of my fists, then my flood of arrows will drink the blood of Rama."

glosses.meaning: the rapid blows of my fists

verses.devanagari:
चिन्तया तप्यसे राजन् किमर्थम् मयि तिष्ठति
सोऽहम् शत्रुविनाशाय तव निर्यातुमुद्यतः |
verses.iast:
cintayā tapyase rājan kimartham mayi tiṣṭhati
so'ham śatruvināśāya tava niryātumudyataḥ |
verses.translation: "O king! When I exist, why do you suffer from anxiety? Here, I am ready to sally forth for the destruction of your enemies."

glosses.meaning: for the destroyable of your enemies.

verses.devanagari:
मुञ्च रामद्भयम् घोरम् निहनिष्यामि सम्युगे
राघवम् लक्ष्मणम् चैव सुग्रीवम् च महाबलम् |
हनूमन्तम् च रक्षोघ्नम् येन लङ्का प्रदीपिता
verses.iast:
muJṇca rāmadbhayam ghoram nihaniṣyāmi samyuge
rāghavam lakṣmaṇam caiva sugrīvam ca mahābalam |
hanūmantam ca rakṣoghnam yena laṇ^kā pradīpitā
verses.translation: "Be free from the terrific fear of Rama. In the battle, I will kill Rama, Lakshmana, the mighty Sugreeva and even Hanuma, by whom the city of Lanka was burnt off and the demons were killed."

glosses.meaning: from the terrific fear of Rama

verses.devanagari:
हरींश्च भक्षयिष्यामि सम्युगे समुपस्थिते |
असाधारणमिच्छमि तव दातुम् महद्यशः
verses.iast:
harīṃśca bhakṣayiṣyāmi samyuge samupasthite |
asādhāraṇamicchami tava dātum mahadyaśaḥ
verses.translation: "I shall devour the monkeys in battle, which is near at hand. I wish to contribute a tremendous and extraordinary reputation for you."

verses.devanagari:
यदिचेन्द्राद्भयम् राजन्यदि चापि स्वयम्भुवः |
ततोऽहम् नाशयिष्यामि नैशम् तम इवांशुमान्
अपि देवाः शयिष्यान्ते मयि क्रुद्धे महीतले |
verses.iast:
yadicendrādbhayam rājanyadi cāpi svayambhuvaḥ |
tato'ham nāśayiṣyāmi naiśam tama ivāṃśumān
api devāḥ śayiṣyānte mayi kruddhe mahītale |
verses.translation: 'O king! If you have a fear for Indra or even for Brahma, I shall remove it then, as the sun removes darkness of the night. When I am enraged, even celestials will lay down on the floor."

verses.devanagari:
यमम् च शमयिष्यामि भक्षयिष्यामि पावकम्
आदित्यम् पातयिष्यामि सनक्षत्रम् महीतले |
verses.iast:
yamam ca śamayiṣyāmi bhakṣayiṣyāmi pāvakam
ādityam pātayiṣyāmi sanakṣatram mahītale |
verses.translation: "I shall extinguish even Yama the god of death. I shall devour the fire-god. I shall cause the sun along with the stars to fall asunder on the floor."

glosses.meaning: even Yama the god of death
I shall cause the sun along with the stars to fall asunder

verses.devanagari:
शतक्रतुम् वधिष्यामि पास्यामि वरुणालयम्
पर्वतांश्चूर्णयिष्यामि दारयिष्यामि मेदिनीम् |
verses.iast:
śatakratum vadhiṣyāmi pāsyāmi varuṇālayam
parvatāṃścūrṇayiṣyāmi dārayiṣyāmi medinīm |
verses.translation: "I shall kill Indra. I shall drink away the ocean. I shall crush the mountains into a powder. I shall tear up the earth."

glosses.meaning: I shall crush the mountains into a powder

verses.devanagari:
दीर्घकालम् प्रसुप्तस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य विक्रमम्
अद्य पश्यन्तु भूतानि भक्ष्यमाणानि सर्वशः |
नन्विदम् त्रिदिवम् सर्वमाहारस्य न पूर्यते
verses.iast:
dīrghakālam prasuptasya kumbhakarṇasya vikramam
adya paśyantu bhūtāni bhakṣyamāṇāni sarvaśaḥ |
nanvidam tridivam sarvamāhārasya na pūryate
verses.translation: "Let all the living beings, being devoured from all sides see today the prowess of Kumbhakarna, who slept for a long time. The entire heaven is not enough for my food."

verses.devanagari:
वधेन ते दाशरथेः सुखावहम् |
सुखम् समाहर्तुमहम् व्रजामि |
निहत्य रामम् सह लक्ष्मणेन |
खादामि सर्वान् हरियूथमुख्यान्
verses.iast:
vadhena te dāśaratheḥ sukhāvaham |
sukham samāhartumaham vrajāmi |
nihatya rāmam saha lakṣmaṇena |
khādāmi sarvān hariyūthamukhyān
verses.translation: "I am going to bring you happiness, conferring you a delight by the destroyal of Rama. Having killed Rama along with Lakshmana, I shall devour all the chiefs of army of monkeys."

glosses.meaning: the chiefs of army of monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
रमस्व राजन् पिब चाद्य वारुणीम् |
कुरुष्व कृत्यानि विनीय दुःखम् |
मयाद्य रामे गमिते यमक्षयम् |
चिराय सीता वशगा भविष्यति
verses.iast:
ramasva rājan piba cādya vāruṇīm |
kuruṣva kṛtyāni vinīya duḥkham |
mayādya rāme gamite yamakṣayam |
cirāya sītā vaśagā bhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "O king! You make merry today and drink wine. Throw away your agony and perform your usual duties. While I send Rama to the world of Yama, the god of death, Seetha will be subservient to your after a log time."

glosses.meaning: to the world of Yama the god of death
